name: Ravenstack — Weekly Churn Risk Digest v3

nodes.name: Every Monday 8 AM
nodes.notes: Fires at 08:00 every Monday. Adjust the cron expression for your timezone.

nodes.name: Fetch Accounts
nodes.notes: Fetches ravenstack_accounts.csv as text from the GitHub raw URL. No env var needed.

nodes.name: Fetch Subscriptions
nodes.notes: Fetches ravenstack_subscriptions.csv as text from the GitHub raw URL. No env var needed.

nodes.name: Fetch Usage
nodes.notes: Fetches ravenstack_feature_usage.csv as text from the GitHub raw URL. No env var needed. continueOnFail is on: if this large file is unreachable, scoring still runs on the other signals.

nodes.name: Score Accounts
nodes.notes: Parses the CSVs and scores every active account with the rule-based model. Replaces the old external Python API. Change TODAY to new Date() for live data.

nodes.name: Any Accounts Flagged?
nodes.notes: True → build and post the digest. False → post an all-clear message.

nodes.name: Build LLM Prompt
nodes.notes: Formats the top 20 accounts into a prompt for Claude.

nodes.name: Generate Alert Text
nodes.notes: Calls the Anthropic Messages API. Paste your key into the x-api-key header value (replace YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

nodes.name: Build Slack Blocks
nodes.notes: Parses Claude's response and builds Slack Block Kit blocks.

nodes.name: Post Digest to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts to a Slack Incoming Webhook. Paste your webhook URL into the URL field (replace YOUR_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL).

parameters.jsonBody: { "text": ":white_check_mark: *Churn Risk Digest* — no accounts cleared the risk threshold this week. All active accounts are below the alert level. See you next Monday." }

nodes.name: Post All-Clear to Slack
nodes.notes: Sent when no accounts are flagged. Paste the same webhook URL here too.
